Instructions

Guide your character through the maze using distance and angle commands. Fewer moves and faster times win!

1. Register your team and course to begin.
2. Enter a distance (in pixels) and press Forward to move.
3. Enter an angle (in degrees) and press Turn Left or Turn Right to change direction.
4. Hitting a wall restarts the level. Reach the exit to save your score!

limitations: Filtered scenario run skips Fetch interception; all requested checks use the local fixture server.
Headless Chrome frame observation is not a real mobile/GPU performance benchmark.
Fixture placement is used to isolate hazards/checkpoint/exit; these are not recorded full-maze solutions.
The isolated scene does not own React move counters or persistence; React observations are reported separately.
Five-minute active-use and real-device coverage remain unmeasured in this initial run.
